description: Third-party client code, unmodified: the shared MCP server's tools make each request with httpx, aiohttp, requests, urllib, the fetch_url() of the official MCP fetch server (mcp-server-fetch 2026.7.10), or the curl binary. Automatic binding (fact_rt); the tools emit no markers and only build the URL. One new connection per call (no reuse). Same reference (destination port -> execution).
